scripts.build:pages: GITHUB_PAGES=true GH_PAGES_REPO=vinStelX npm run build && rm -rf docs && cp -r out docs && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.build:domain: npm run build && rm -rf docs && cp -r out docs && touch docs/.nojekyll && echo vinstelx.com > docs/CNAME
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes serve out -l 3000
scripts.preview:pages: npm run build:pages && rm -rf .preview && mkdir -p .preview/vinStelX && cp -r docs/. .preview/vinStelX/ && npx --yes serve .preview -l 3000
scripts.preview:domain: npm run build:domain && npx --yes serve docs -l 3000
